original_value: A fictional off-grid emergency radio built for quiet cabins, field kits, and blackout preparedness. The Orchid Loom 7W uses a handcrank generator with a built-in rechargeable battery, analog AM/FM reception, NOAA weather band support, and a compact LED reading lamp. Its rugged ABS shell and rubberized carry handle are intended for simple, low-power use rather than high-performance computing or storage workloads.
